title: After company news, a confirmed move: does it continue or fade, against a move of the same size on a day with no news?
hypothesis: A stock move that comes with company news and is confirmed (at the open for news made public overnight; about 15 minutes later for news in session) goes on further in the same direction to the close than a move of the same size on a day with no news, and more for some kinds of news than others. Prior idea: Chan (2003, US stocks) found that big moves with news drifted on and big moves without news tended to reverse.
prior_evidence_here: V02T (13 NSE announcement categories) and HFN1/HFN1T (a news model's tone) found no drift over 5 and 20 sessions measured from the close of the news day. NC1 asks a different question: what happens inside the session, after the move is confirmed.

data.announcements: silver/announce/announcements.parquet, public time from 2010-01-01 to 2023-12-29 (research years only; never 2024+ or the sealed folders). Public time = the exchange dissemination time where kept (2020 on), else the announcement time: where both exist they agree within a minute (10th, 50th and 90th percentile gaps 0, 0 and 1 minute)
data.part_A_prices: gold/bars/adj_daily (adjusted open and close), the stocks in gold/universe/u_liq_in top500 that day; days in gold/ca_flags (corporate actions) dropped; Nifty 50 open and close from silver/kite_index day
data.part_B_prices: silver/kite_5m kite_close, 2015-2023 (447 to 635 stocks a year); Nifty 50 5-minute bars from silver/kite_index/5minute; a stock-day needs a bar at or after 15:15 (k 72) to count

kinds.order_win: a new order, contract or award won
kinds.usfda_adverse: a US drug regulator warning, import alert or inspection observations
kinds.rating_down: a credit rating cut or a negative outlook
kinds.rating_up: a credit rating raised or a positive outlook
kinds.fund_raising: raising equity: a QIP, a rights issue or a preferential issue
kinds.merger_acquisition: an acquisition, merger, demerger, stake sale or joint venture
kinds.holding_change: a disclosure of shares bought or sold by promoters or insiders
kinds.management_exit: a resignation or exit of a chief executive, finance chief, managing or whole-time director, or chairman
kinds.pledge_default: pledged shares, an invoked pledge, a missed payment or insolvency
kinds.regulatory_legal: a penalty, search, show-cause notice, regulator order or court matter
kinds.dividend_bonus_split: a dividend, bonus issue or share split
kinds.operations_up: a new plant, capacity, launch or start of commercial production
kinds.disruption: a fire, accident, shutdown, strike, lockout, flood or cyber attack
kinds.analyst_meet: a scheduled analyst or investor meeting or presentation (routine: the control kind)

dictionary.routine: lost share certificates, trading window, newspaper copies, record and book closure dates, meeting notices, and exchange queries about a price move (which follow the move): never news; a stock-day with only these counts as a day with no news
dictionary.rule: an announcement can carry several kinds; 'all_news' is every non-routine announcement, of a listed kind or not; the run refuses to start if the module's sha256 differs from this one

timing.A: made public after 15:30 on a session day (the next session), on a day with no session (the next session), or at or before 09:00 on a session day (that session)
timing.B: made public from 09:20 to 15:00 on a session day; the event is the stock-day's first such news
timing.edge: 09:00-09:20 and 15:00-15:30: never an event, but counted as the day's news (so such a day is never a no-news day)

part_A.confirmed: abnormal gap = (open / previous close - 1) minus the Nifty's same; |abnormal gap| >= 2%
part_A.cont: sign(gap) x [(close / open - 1) minus the Nifty's (close / open - 1)]: positive = the move went on, negative = it faded
part_A.baseline: confirmed gaps on top-500 stock-days with no news at all that day (overnight or in session), same quarter and same direction
part_A.five_sessions: sign(gap) x [(close 4 sessions on / open - 1) minus the Nifty's same]: descriptive only

part_B.confirmed: the reference price is the close of the last 5-minute bar ended at or before the news; the confirmation price the close of the bar 15 minutes after that (10 to 15 minutes after the news); abnormal move = the stock's minus the Nifty's; |move| >= 1%
part_B.cont: sign(move) x [(the day's last close / confirmation price - 1) minus the Nifty's same]
part_B.baseline: confirmed 15-minute moves of stocks with no news at all that day, taken every 15 minutes from the bar ending 09:25 to the bar ending 15:00; matched by quarter, direction and time of day (09:20-10:30, 10:30-12:00, 12:00-13:30, 13:30-15:00)
part_B.split: dev 2015-2018, validation 2019-2023: the 5-minute bars start in 2015, and this split gives each period at least the registry's 16 quarters

rows_words: for each part (A, B) and each of the 17 kinds plus all_news: '<part>|<kind>|cont' (the confirmed move went on to the close) and '<part>|<kind>|edge' (it went on further than a no-news move of the same direction): 72 rows, each expecting +1; a significant minus in both periods reads OPPOSITE (the move fades)
statistics: calendar-quarter blocks: one mean per quarter, t over the quarter means, dev and validation apart; at least 16 quarters per period (registry MIN_DATES), else INCONCLUSIVE; |returns| above 50% dropped as bad prints

bar.why: 42 events-family rows and 16 news_tone rows in the ledger on 25 Nov 2026, plus these 72; two-sided Bonferroni
bar.rule: registry standard: VALIDATED needs |t| >= z in both periods with the expected sign; CONDITIONAL z in one and 1.65 in the other

descriptive: responsiveness: for each kind, how often its news gave a confirmed move (A and B), how big, which way, and what followed
movers: of each session's 25 biggest gainers and 25 biggest losers (top 500, the day's move beyond the Nifty), the share with news of each kind that day, against all stock-days (the lift)
five sessions: the confirmed overnight moves' further move over 5 sessions
what_a_pass_means: that kind of news, once its move is confirmed, tends to go on (or, if OPPOSITE, to fade). It is NOT a trade: the moves are before costs (a round trip costs about 0.3-0.5%), and a paper rule would need its own registered forward test against random and Madhav's yes
integration: the results reach Ananta through the ledger (the registry and the knowledge map's research facts) and the plain-words results page; the live line 'movers and their news' (india/movernews.py) tags each session's biggest movers with the same kinds for the morning review. No book, rule, score or decision reads any of it
